page.notes: The Hebrew words are printed in Hebrew letters, and my readings of them are uncertain, so each is marked [?]. The ink blot over "sustentabatur" obscures part of the word, though it is legible. The "ras" catchword sits at the right below the last line. Printed spellings such as "Hieronymus" and "Epi-phanium" are kept, while qv has been normalised to qu (qvæ→quæ) per the u/v rule. Printed "Viginti" and "Exercit." are kept as they appear.
